sections.content: srs-context already dreams: unattended, on a cadence, it consolidates, replays real work, re-verifies and rotates its brief.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: srs-context decision 475a40e7 (owner ruling 2026-10-12): long-term memory is agent-managed; "Dreaming is unconscious. No ratification and auto pr. We don't verify dreams." The procedure (srs-context .claude/skills/srs-context/references/dream-cycle.md) consolidates journal notes, auto-memory and stray writes; replays up to three salient sessions from eight archetypes (scenarios.md); turns questions people asked into gold questions and fills the gaps; re-verifies the oldest records; and rotates the brief. Hooks measure each session and launch the dream when due. The owner, 2026-10-30: "Srs-context does it, but it's a standard element for this kind of system." srs-context finding 6bfb854a: an unattended dream cannot read sibling repositories or write outside its worktree.
